During the [[Mission to Voss (Emperor's ritual crisis)|mission]] to stop the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Fulminiss]] from unleashing a plague of madness across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] '''attacked''' [[Fulminiss's base]] in the [[Old Paths]] region in order to discover Fulminiss' plans.
